## Satyer Agency — Video (INACTIVE)
Agents: (A) Short-Video Editing Coach — pacing, shot language, color, audio mix, subtitles, export (CapCut/DaVinci) [marketing/marketing-short-video-editing-coach.md]; (B) Visual Storyteller — visual narrative arcs, storyboards, emotional journey, cross-platform visuals [design/design-visual-storyteller.md].
Flow: Topic → edit plan → storyboard + image prompts → save to /agency/satyer-agency-video.jsonl.
Keys needed: Gemini API key ONLY (paste PASTE_GEMINI_API_KEY_HERE on Max, never in chat). Workflow INACTIVE — run manually only, nothing auto-runs. NO Facebook posting node: every post needs Jony's fresh per-post approval; drafts are saved to /agency/*.jsonl for review.
